{{Quote|Is this pitiful existence so much to lose? We have lost our families, our homeworld, our freedom&mdash;we have ''nothing'' else left!|Tuktee|<ref name="TCW 6">[[The Clone Wars 6|''The Clone Wars'' 6]]</ref>}}
'''Tuktee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] from the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Tuktee and his entire [[Artisan colony/Legends|colony]] were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and handed to the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]] who sent them to their [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|slave processing facility]] on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]]. Tuktee and the others were soon joined by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] who had gone to [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] in order to find and save the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists, but had eventually been captured by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] as well.<ref name="EfK" />

While mining [[Kadavo ore|ore]] in the slave processing facility, Tuktee was lashed by a Zygerrian slaver's [[Shock whip|electro-whip]], as it happened to any slave who fell out of line. He and his people were later [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|rescued]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces led by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="EfK" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tuktee.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Tuktee, as he appeared in the ''Slaves of the Republic'' comics]]
The character of Tuktee was voiced by [[Matt Lanter]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]].<ref name="EfK" />

In the original story released by [[Dark Horse Comics]], ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Slaves of the Republic]]'', Tuktee could be seen laboring in the slave processing facility and later falling, along with [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]] whom he had tried to save, from a platform above a [[Magma/Legends|lava]] pit, shortly before being [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] rescued by the Jedi. In the ''Clone Wars'' episode, he was seen being whipped by a Zygerrian slaver in the facility.<ref name="TCW 6" />
